translation:
I started using Nagato's mop to erase the
singularities, just as I did before.

Please be as quick as you can. Miss Suzumiya
will return before long.
Yeah, I get it.
What would Haruhi see if she came back now?

An empty hallway? The entrance to class
1-10?

Seriously, if she came in here, what would
become of the world?

I absolutely cannot accept a world where
such strange things are normal.

Or even worse, the destruction of the world,
right?

I put force into my mopping arm while thinking
about that.

Not that I have any idea if mopping with
strength even makes a difference.

So, I continued sweeping around the class-
room…I can only wonder how much time passed.

I was mopping so frantically that I had lost
any sense of time.

I'd lost count of how many singularities I
erased, but just as I finished one of them…
Whoa!

I was overwhelmed by blinding light and dizzi-
ness, and suddenly thrown into the hallway.

I lost my sense of orientation and balance in
the sheer immediacy of it.

As soon as I noticed, there was a hard
linoleum hallway before my eyes.
Ouch…
Are the two of you unhurt?
Do I look unhurt to you?
It would appear that you are just fine.
Yeah, exactly.

If there were a problem, it would be that my
nose hurts like death.
Or something as trivial as slight dizziness.
Good grief, that was quite the experience.
Oh, right, where's Nagato…?
Here.

Unlike me, it seems she didn't burst out into
the hallway like an idiot.
Are you hurt anywhere?
No issues.
Aren't you at all worried about me?

It means the world to me to see you looking so
well.
Yes, fortunately.

By the way, what happened? This is a normal
place, right?

We do seem to be in the original space. Isn't
that correct, Miss Nagato?

Yes. The original space and time. Alternate
space was destroyed.

It seems that somehow, we were thrown out of
that alternate space when it disappeared.

Is it safe to essentially assume we're in the
clear?
It certainly seems so, for the time being.
What are you all doing?
Haruhi?!

What are you doing just sitting in the
hallway? Plus your nose.
Huh…?
You've got a nosebleed.
What?

I wiped my finger under my nose, and there
was blood, just as Haruhi said.
What were you doing? That's disgusting.
Haruhi squinted her eyes at me with suspicion.
W-wait, you're misunderstanding!
Unbelievable, this is why you're—
Listen to me, I beg you!
About Haruhi
